Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands over his patient, Jack, who sits on a hospital bed, staring blankly into space 🤯. Dr. Smith holds out a small glass of medication, his expression firm but concerned 😬.

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, it's time for your medication. Please take it, it's for your own good 💊."

JACK:
"I don't want it. I don't need it. I'm fine." 🙅‍♂️

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, you know the risks. You know what it can do to your mind 🤯. You need to take it, trust me." 💯

JACK:
"I don't trust you. I don't trust anyone." 🚫

Dr. Smith's expression softens, and he takes a step closer to Jack, his voice taking on a gentle tone 🤗.

DR. SMITH:
"Jack, I'm here to help you. I want to help you. Please, just take the pills, and we'll get through this together 💕."

Jack looks up at Dr. Smith, his eyes flashing with defiance 🔥.

JACK:
"I won't take it. I won't be controlled." 💪

Dr. Smith's face sets in a determined expression, and he reaches out to take the glass from Jack's hand 🤝.

DR. SMITH:
"Fine. If you won't take it, then I'll take it for you." 💊

Dr. Smith pours the pills into his own hand, and as he does, the camera zooms in on his face, his eyes taking on a wild, manic glint 🤪.

CUT TO:

INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - LATER 🕰️

Dr. Smith sits in his office, staring blankly at a file on his desk, his eyes unfocused and distant 🤯. Suddenly, he looks up, and his eyes snap into focus, revealing a look of utter confusion 😱.

DR. SMITH:
"Where's Jack?" 🤔

He looks around the room, but there is no sign of the patient. He gets up and walks out of the office, into the hospital corridors, calling out for Jack 🗣️.

DR. SMITH:
"Jack! Jack, where are you?" 🗣️

As he walks, the camera follows him, revealing that the hospital corridors are empty, and there is no sign of Jack or any other patients 🏥. Dr. Smith's expression changes from confusion to realization, and he slumps against a wall, his eyes wide with horror 😨.

CUT TO:

INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - LATER 🕰️

Dr. Smith sits in his office, staring at his reflection in a mirror, his eyes wild and manic 🔥. The camera zooms in on his face, revealing a look of utter madness 😱.

DR. SMITH:
"I'm the one who's been delusional all along." 🤯

The camera pans out, revealing that Dr. Smith is sitting in a padded cell, surrounded by hospital equipment and medication bottles 💊. The screen fades to black, as the sound of Dr. Smith's maniacal laughter echoes through the asylum 🎃.

👻
